crafts.name: Pencil Holder
instructions: Remove stickers from the jar by scraping them off or using hot water
Paint the jar with desired patterns and designs
Decorate with ribbons, stickers, or gems if desired
Put stationery inside and your pencil holder is complete!
crafts.sustainability_note: The glass jar is suitable for a holder because it is durable, transparent, and easy to clean.
environmental_benefits: Reduces the need to buy mass-produced plastic desk organizers

crafts.name: Plant Pot
instructions: Remove stickers from the jar by scraping them off or using hot water
Clean and dry the jar to remove any residue
Paint the outside of the jar and add decorations if desired
Place small pebbles at the bottom of the jar for drainage
Place a small amount of activated charcoal over the pebbles
Pour a thick layer of soil over the pebbles and charcoal
Plant a seed into the soil or place a small plant into the soil
crafts.sustainability_note: The sturdy glass jar provides a reusable home for plant growth and supports indoor gardening.
environmental_benefits: Creates a small indoor air-purifying plant space

crafts.name: Night Light
instructions: Remove stickers from the jar by scraping them off or using hot water
Paint and decorate the jar, leaving a space in the middle for the light to shine through
Place string lights inside the jar
crafts.sustainability_note: The glass jar is upcycled into a long-lasting reusable night light.
